errors.evidence: The description completely omits the main purpose of the chart, which is to compare motivation levels based on whether employees have a choice of workplace ('Възможност за избор на работно място'). It only mentions the comparison between home and office work.

The description fails to mention the chart is divided into two distinct sections, labeled 'НЕ' (No) and 'ДА' (Yes), which is the primary grouping variable. It treats the four bars in two groups as if there were only two bars in total.
The description misreads the y-axis label 'Ниво на мотивация' (Level of motivation) as 'Ниво на вкръзи', which is nonsensical.

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стойност е 10, а най-високата е 40.
errors.evidence: This misrepresents the range of the data. The lowest data value shown is approximately 18, and the highest is approximately 41. The values 10 and 40 correspond to axis ticks, not the data range.

errors.text_span: Стълбата, отбелязваща „От вкъщи“, достига височина от около 25, докато стълбата, отбелязваща „От офис“, достига височина от около 40.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect as there are two bars for each category. For 'От вкъщи', the values are approx. 18 and 35, neither of which is 25. For 'От офис', the values are approx. 24 and 41; while 41 is close to 40, the description completely ignores the bar at 24.

The chart contains four bars, not two. Two of the bars (in the 'НЕ' group) are green, and two (in the 'ДА' group) are blue. The description incorrectly states there are only two bars and that both are blue.
